items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ... Chombo Silva came in from France or wherever he was at. ... [INTERVIEWEE] Yes.

ctx.x: Tito Puente yes, Tito Rodriguez, never.

Okay, in 1957 Batista, Fulgencio Batista, asked for all Cuban musicians around the world to go back for a two-week holiday. There was a reunion. You went, Mario Bauza went, a lot of Cubans. Chombo Silva came in from France or wherever he was at. They came from all over the world. Do you remember that ....
